values.subject: Jiaxing Jisu Manufacturing: Personnel Information Required for Security Pre-Screening
values.body_text: To use our fast-track process, your company needs to send us all employees’ ID numbers and personal health notes in one batch. Once we enter them into the site security system, we can secure the slots that same day. Please reply to the email directly with the materials; the form does not need to be signed. The slots are held only until this Friday.
